timing.primary: individual ABBA on-raw minus off-raw synchronous dispatch latency (syncMs)
timing.control: individual ACCA on-raw minus off-normalized synchronous dispatch latency (syncMs)
timing.secondary: both comparisons repeated for settledMs: dispatch through one fixed microtask continuation
timing.includes: syncMs includes dispatch only; settledMs additionally includes receipt and default feedback DOM updates
timing.theme: existing public domternal-theme.css, with layout or paint excluded unless dispatch itself forces them
timing.separation: one animation frame opportunity outside timing before every operation
timing.excludes: OS clipboard, editor construction/reset, validation, hashing, startup, next paint, asynchronous assets
